method: Invoke packaged production HullVolumeCatalog, HullDriveScaleCatalog and ShipBalanceMath via reflection for all 64 catalog appearances; summarize by hull class.

units.mainHull_m3: measured exterior main-hull elliptical envelope, cubic metres; fuel allowance input before module/crew deductions
units.reactorEngineBay_m3: reactor-bay capacity and engine-bay UI input, cubic metres; measured only for 12 human hull classes
units.deLaval: dimensionless engine-art area multiplier, not volume
units.magnetic: dimensionless engine-art area multiplier, not volume

median: unweighted numeric median across authored modelResource appearances; even-count median is average of the middle two values
